name: Pennacrest
ability: Keen Eye / Big Pecks / Cheek Pouch (hidden)
look: a great brooding bird with a long white neck striped red, a broad hat-brim red crest, big grey eyes with dark marks, a spiky white chest ruff with black chevrons, folded brown wings and four long banded streamers
entry: The matriarch of a crag-top nest. It broods over the chicks with its broad crest spread like a parasol to shade them, and drives off any intruder with a storm of beating wings and lashing streamers.
how: Evolve Pinnant at level 36. It learns Brave Bird when it evolves.
Wild: rare at pinbird nests (rocky crags topped with a great hay nest, in plains, meadows, savannas and windswept hills).
